description: This file defines a PHP class 'Autoloader' responsible for dynamically loading class files based on namespace registration, following PSR-4 standards. It manages namespace-to-directory mappings and autoloads class files accordingly within the OpenCart framework.
published:
Opencart	he
amespace	he ull

classes.name: Autoloader
classes.description: A class responsible for registering namespace-to-directory mappings and dynamically loading PHP class files based on these mappings following PSR-4 standard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Registers the PHP autoload function to load classes when they are instantiated.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Associates a namespace with a directory path, optionally specifying if the namespace follows PSR-4 standards.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Attempts to load the class file corresponding to the given fully qualified class name based on registered namespace mappings.
